doc: Event script for the Heim Rada field map g04. It holds the time gate warp scene (red and blue gate rings around Max and Monica, then a white-out and a caption that they jumped to the future), the arrival run-in scenes, the prompts for leaving to Heim Rada Stop (s10) and for entering dungeon 4, and the checks for pending story events 548, 552, 556 and 560. Using the gate sends the player on to Gundorada Workshop (f04), or to s39 when event 560 is pending.
